dt.display_name: 第二部分：光纤驱动裂缝数字孪生

summary.anti_circularity_design: Fiber cumulative liquid shares drive historical PKN cluster rates and smoothed incremental fiber liquid allocation drives current-rate/aperture inputs; EnKF does not contain a free cluster growth/intake factor.
summary.allocation_method: fiber incremental liquid allocation with light EMA smoothing and nonnegative conservation normalization
summary.validation_design: First 70% calibrates the state. Online validation scores each held-out step before update, then assimilates the arriving observation and scores the posterior; frozen mode does not update held-out steps.
limitations: Cluster liquid/sand shares constrain intake allocation, not independently measured fracture geometry.
The sand transport observation operator is a cumulative, mean-preserving sublinear q_effective*aperture capacity proxy; it is not a full particle-transport solver.
Pressure friction defaults require client calibration before field interpretation.
The 50% cumulative leakoff cap is an engineering prior and must be recalibrated when formation leakoff measurements are available.
The EnKF state is intentionally limited to E', C_L, mu and sigma_min; cluster allocation is measured input, not a free state.

das_cluster_observation.display_name: 有 DAS：压力 + 分簇观测校验

dt.metrics_scope: 第8段光纤分簇液砂份额与井底压力的观测空间留出验证
limitations: 当前没有独立真实裂缝半长真值；缝长误差采用PKN输出与光纤液量/砂量等效分配估计的差异
缝长误差采用与PKN幂律一致的液量^0.6等效水力估计，不等同于独立几何真值
液量分配为PKN边界输入，液量误差是输入一致性校验；砂量误差来自累计携砂容量代理
压力摩阻参数仍需甲方现场参数校准
